description: Extract every string of copy in the file (or in one subtree via `scope`), in document order: guid, layer name, the characters, the page, and the base typography (font, size, line-height, colour). With includeRuns:true each node also carries its styled runs — the mixed-format spans Figma stores per UTF-16 code unit — with only the fields each run overrides. With a `scope`, the text inside component instances is included as those instances show it. Use this for copy audits and translation passes rather than walking the tree.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous truncated response; resumes where it stopped.

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

includePath.description: Include the ancestor breadcrumb per node (default false; costs tokens).

includeRuns.description: Include per-run style overrides (default false; costs many more tokens).

includeStyle.description: Include font / size / line-height / colour per node (default true).

instances.description: Walk into component instances and list the layers they show, with their overrides applied (ids like "I2:1329;0:2528"). Default true with a `scope`; for the whole file the default lists the text layers stored in it (component definitions included) without walking every instance.

scope.description: Only collect text inside this guid subtree. A Figma node-id or link works too.

name: fig_text
title: Text inventory
